execution_assumptions.dispatch_owner: Root only; serialized dispatch decisions, including a confirmed active first job before starting a second. Independent concurrent CLI launchers are unsupported.
execution_assumptions.global_heavy_slots: Root grants cover all emulator, focused, canonical and native jobs, including non-container participants. Docker active-name check is a supplemental guard, not an atomic multi-agent scheduler.
execution_assumptions.licensing_network: Retain same host network mode as the validated V110 Count control. No hostid/MAC modification.

functional_contract: Preserve exact V110 public cycles/invalid/error/counter/debug/memory behavior and prior declared private/conditional scopes. New private header stages coherent at consuming HEADER; no added public cycle.
